info.title: NOVA Store API
info.description: Stable OpenAPI 3.1 transport contract for the NOVA API. It is the reviewable source of truth for routes, standard security/query/body parameters, response envelopes, and consumer-facing nested schemas.

302.description: Redirect to a short-lived private derivative URL.

get.summary: List all published content page summaries
get.description: Returns the complete published content page index in deterministic slug-ascending order. The response is intentionally summary-only and is not paginated so sitemap generation cannot omit eligible published pages.

x-nova-csrf.reason: Provider callback is signature-validated and marked @SkipCsrf.
Provider redirect callback is verified by the configured gateway and marked @SkipCsrf.

IdempotencyKey.name: idempotency-key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable replay key required for checkout submission.

OptionalIdempotencyKey.name: idempotency-key
OptionalIdempotencyKey.description: Optional stable replay key for cart item creation.

PaymentSignature.name: x-payment-signature
PaymentSignature.description: Provider callback signature forwarded to the configured payment gateway.

ContentPageIndex.description: Complete published content page summary index envelope

CatalogMediaUploadPlan.description: Private catalog media upload plan envelope

ApiError401.description: Customer or staff authentication is required

ApiError403.description: CSRF validation or staff role authorization failed

ApiError409.description: State conflict, duplicate mutation, or optimistic concurrency conflict

ApiError422.description: Unprocessable validation error emitted by the API exception filter

customerSession.name: nova_session
customerSession.description: Customer session cookie issued by POST /v1/auth/otp/verify.

staffSession.name: nova_staff_session
staffSession.description: Staff session cookie issued by POST /v1/staff/auth/login.

csrfToken.name: x-csrf-token
csrfToken.description: For unsafe browser requests, send the value of the nova_csrf cookie. The server also requires an Origin matching the configured web origin.
